description: issue #874's gating half: the SAME source as arity-paren-home-too-many, checked without `turtle-rendering` active. `home` is then not a visible name, so its arity is not statically known and the call belongs to ol-unknown-command alone — exactly ONE finding, never an arity one alongside it. This is `spec/tooling.md:175-176` ("MUST use the active conformance profile set when deciding which primitives … are available") and the two rules' never-double-report contract, which the fix makes structural by arity-checking only names the unknown-command rule already considers visible.
